feedback: Reed's confession follows the marked proof and contradicted denial directly, so the reveal feels earned. Taking poison during the preview and adding it to the waiting glass supplies the precise mechanics, but those actions explain the already established source, access, contamination, and false harmless caption rather than introducing a new decisive clue. The line about wanting a name on the work and getting it on the murder gives the academic ambition an effective emotional consequence. Chip and Barb's responses also fit their documented failures without erasing responsibility. The confession is concise and satisfying, though its tidy sequence reinforces how much the accusation depended on interpreting one documentary lie among many shared opportunities.
